scope: Reviewed feature inventory and known corner cases. Every portable scenario, protocol vector and named native feature has an explicit disposition. Evidence scope is checked separately from execution; no claim covers every possible value, scheduler interleaving, backend failure or feature product.

features.title: Public API and configuration binding
features.scope: Wrapper registration, inline loading, validation timing, typed arguments and policy snapshots are explicit native API obligations.

features.title: Request enablement and ownership
features.scope: Outside, nested, disabled, detached, closed and replacement contexts distinguish request lifetime from unfinished external work.

features.title: Cache layers and value reuse
features.scope: Request/local/remote traversal, falsy values, per-instance LRU capacity, insertion TTL, logical freshness and physical expiry have named boundary cases.

features.title: Shared and independent callers
features.scope: Same-key leaders and followers, independent operations, policy changes, failure cleanup and last-completion publication retain separate ownership.

features.title: Runtime policy and rollout
features.scope: Sparse inheritance, explicit values, invalid-leaf consequences, kill switches, deterministic cohort boundaries and captured policy are reviewed separately.

features.title: Read and source budgets
features.scope: Budget precedence, start time, full elapsed duration, exact boundaries, late settlement, unbounded source work and cancellation requests are distinct cases.

features.title: Failure isolation and adapter normalization
features.scope: Key/provider/cache/codec/observer failures preserve the specified source outcome; explicit maintenance failures surface and adapter metadata is normalized.

features.title: Tracked invalidation and publication fences
features.scope: Entity grouping, strict fences, acquired snapshots, delayed writes, two fence checks, retention bounds and atomic invalidation rejection are covered.

features.title: Stale recovery
features.scope: Candidate eligibility at fresh/maximum/future boundaries, classifier precedence, original errors, captured bytes and late or independent sources are explicit.

features.title: Shadow admission, validation and fills
features.scope: Served and dark paths distinguish caller/source ownership, C0/C1 confirmation, diagnostic outcomes, fill authority and capacity retained by unfinished work.

features.title: Keys, codecs, compression and Redis integration
features.scope: Exact key/frame/envelope compatibility and supported value domains are paired with real Redis dispatch, primary reads and cross-language integration.

features.title: Diagnostics and exporters
features.scope: Error categories, phase durations, ages, sizes, coalescing inspection, warning eligibility, exporter schemas and collector ownership remain distinct obligations.
